commentaryList.commText: 19.6 Jasprit Bumrah to Shimron Hetmyer, SIX runs! Full toss, right in the slot, and Hetmyer sends it soaring over the deep midwicket boundary! Unbelievable shot under pressure! What a finish!
19.5 Jasprit Bumrah to Shimron Hetmyer, FOUR! A low full toss on the pads, Hetmyer glances it fine and it beats the short fine leg fielder to speed away to the boundary.

19.4 Jasprit Bumrah to Riyan Parag, OUT! Caught! Bumrah strikes! A perfect slower-ball bouncer, Parag tries to pull but only gets a top edge. The wicketkeeper takes an easy catch. Parag departs after a brilliant cameo. Riyan Parag c Ishan Kishan b Jasprit Bumrah 34(18) [4s-3 6s-2]
19.3 Jasprit Bumrah to Riyan Parag, no run. A searing yorker right at the blockhole, Parag jams it out back to the bowler. Dot ball at a crucial moment!
19.2 Jasprit Bumrah to Riyan Parag, 2 runs. Full and wide outside off, Parag slices it over extra cover. The fielder at deep cover sweeps it up quickly to prevent the boundary.
19.1 Jasprit Bumrah to Riyan Parag, SIX! Parag stands tall and deposits this length delivery over long-on! What a clean strike to start the final over!
18.6 Gerald Coetzee to Shimron Hetmyer, 2 runs. Short ball, Hetmyer pulls it away towards deep square leg and runs hard to pick up a brace.
18.5 Gerald Coetzee to Shimron Hetmyer, FOUR! Slashed away! Width offered outside off, Hetmyer flashes hard and gets a thick outside edge that flies past the short third man fielder.
18.4 Gerald Coetzee to Riyan Parag, 1 run. Full toss on middle, driven down to long-on for a single.
18.3 Gerald Coetzee to Riyan Parag, FOUR! Short of a length, Parag pulls it beautifully through the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket. Boundary!
